Brand Introduction:
Flash Relief is dedicated to helping athletes recover faster and perform at their best. Our cutting-edge recovery tools are designed to relieve muscle soreness, enhance circulation, and accelerate healing—so athletes can train harder, recover smarter, and stay ahead of the competition.

Product Description:
Our core product line includes:
✅ Flash Relief Pro – A powerful EMS massager that targets deep muscle recovery, reduces soreness, and improves mobility.
✅ FlashStep Pro – An advanced foot EMS massager that stimulates blood flow, relieves foot fatigue, and enhances lower-body recovery.
✅ FlashMax Ultimate Recovery Bundle – A complete recovery system combining the Flash Relief Pro, FlashStep Pro, and EMS pads & cords for full-body muscle relief and optimized performance.

Unique Selling Points (USP):
🔹 Specifically designed for athletes, backed by science.
🔹 Portable and easy-to-use for recovery anywhere, anytime.
🔹 Helps reduce soreness, improve circulation, and accelerate muscle healing.
🔹 More affordable than expensive physiotherapy or massage sessions.
🔹 Proven by top athletes and trainers for peak recovery.

Payment Terms:
💰 Influencer/Affiliate Commission – Earn 25% per sale generated through your unique link.
💳 Secure Payment Processing – We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and Buy Now, Pay Later options.
📦 Fast Shipping – Quick and reliable worldwide shipping.

Other Information:
📲 Marketing Support – We provide high-quality content, ad creatives, and strategies to help affiliates maximize sales.
🚀 Scalable Opportunity – Be part of a growing brand with a high-demand product in the sports & recovery niche.
💯 Satisfaction Guarantee – We stand by our product’s effectiveness with a hassle-free return policy.

Let me know if you need any refinements! 🔥
